groups.label: Institute Day and converted planning days
items: One no-student Institute Day will fall during February 8–12, 2027; the exact date is determined by island.
Two instructional days are converted to non-student days for school planning and collaboration. Confirm the dates with the school.

groups.label: Teacher work year
items: HIDOE lists a 193-day teacher work year. Teachers report to campus for 189 days, while four additional days are converted to 27 hours: 21 hours for job-embedded professional development and six hours for training, planning, assessment, or teacher-evaluation meetings.

groups.label: Student hours and graduation
items: Hawaii schools are required to provide a 180-day school year totaling 1,080 hours.
Class of 2027 commencement exercises may be scheduled no earlier than May 21, 2027. Individual schools set their own ceremony dates.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
whatsNew.subtitle: A concise comparison with the prior HIDOE calendar.
content: The first student day moves from August 4 in 2025–26 to August 3 in 2026–27.
The last student day moves from May 28 to May 27.
Fall Break moves from October 6–10 to October 5–9.
Winter Break moves from December 22–January 2 to December 21–January 1, and Spring Break moves from March 16–20 to March 15–19.
HIDOE continues to list 180 student days, while teachers report to campus for 189 days.

faqDisplayQuestions: Does this calendar apply to every Hawaii public school?
What is the HIDOE Institute Day, and when is it in 2027?
Why is Kūhiō Day observed on March 29 in the school calendar?
Why does HIDOE have a 193-day teacher work year if teachers report to campus for 189 days?
How early can Class of 2027 graduation ceremonies be held?

calendarFaqs.q: Does this calendar apply to every Hawaii public school?
calendarFaqs.a: No. HIDOE says the statewide 2026–27 calendar applies to Hawaii public schools except Holomua Elementary and charter schools. School-level events such as testing, athletics, transportation changes, and ceremonies may also require a campus calendar or announcement.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the HIDOE Institute Day, and when is it in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: One no-student Educational Officer and Teacher Institute Day will occur during February 8–12, 2027. HIDOE does not publish one statewide date for it; the exact day is determined separately for each island.

calendarFaqs.q: Why is Kūhiō Day observed on March 29 in the school calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Prince Jonah Kūhiō Kalanianaʻole Day falls on March 26 in 2027, the same date as Good Friday. The amended HIDOE school calendar lists Good Friday on March 26 and observes Kūhiō Day for schools on Monday, March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does HIDOE have a 193-day teacher work year if teachers report to campus for 189 days?
calendarFaqs.a: HIDOE defines a 193-day teacher work year. Teachers report to campus for 189 days, while four additional days are converted to 27 hours for professional development, training, planning, assessment, or teacher-evaluation meetings.

calendarFaqs.q: How early can Class of 2027 graduation ceremonies be held?
calendarFaqs.a: HIDOE says Class of 2027 commencement exercises may be scheduled no sooner than May 21, 2027. That is the earliest permitted date, not a statewide ceremony date; individual schools publish their own graduation schedules.

sourceReviewSummary: Official calendar approved June 1, 2023, and amended March 30, 2026. MySchoolDates reviewed the current HIDOE calendar page and the complete one-page amended PDF on August 20, 2026.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How the amended Hawaii calendar was checked
sourceReviewDetails: We reviewed the complete date grid, semester and quarter labels, state holidays, teacher work-year notes, and every footnote in the amended PDF.
We also checked the HIDOE calendar page for calendar coverage, graduation timing, the official Google Calendar, and the 180-day/1,080-hour requirement.
Dates without a single statewide value, including Institute Day, are not represented as fixed dates in our ICS file.
